Question: Michael walks at the rate of \(5\) feet per second on a long straight path. Trash pails are located every \(200\) feet along the path. A garbage truck travels at \(10\) feet per second in the same direction as Michael and stops for \(30\) seconds at each pail. As Michael passes a pail, he notices the truck ahead of him just leaving the next pail. How many times will Michael and the truck meet?
